This page is styled by [Marx](https://mblode.github.io/marx/), which is loaded from a CDN via the `css` field
above. Nothing else is applied to the page: litedown's default stylesheet is not
used.

Marx limits the width of `<main>` but not of `<header>`, so we give the title
block the same width with a little CSS:

```{css, echo = FALSE}
header {
  max-width: 40rem;
  margin: auto;
}
```

## Text

Plain text can be *emphasized*, **strong**, ~~deleted~~, or `inline code`, and
it can contain [links](https://yihui.org/litedown/) and footnotes.[^1]

> A block quote is a good place to quote someone.

1.  A numbered item.
2.  Another item.

-   A bullet item.
-   Another item.

[^1]: A footnote.

## Code and output

```{r}
summary(cars)
```

## Diagram

```{pele, echo = FALSE}
#| fig.cap = 'How an R Markdown document becomes a styled HTML page.'
flowchart LR
  A@{ shape: doc, label: "*.Rmd" }-. <code>fuse()</code> .-> B@{ shape: doc, label: "*.md" }
  B-- <code>mark()</code> -->C@{ shape: doc, label: "*.html" }
  D@{ shape: cyl, label: "CSS (CDN)" }-. <code>css</code> .->C
  C==>E@{ shape: stadium, label: "Styled page" }
```
